title: Cracked cylindrical concrete specimen on compression platen
objects_and_counts: One cylindrical concrete specimen is visible, placed vertically and showing a large vertical crack on its side; the specimen is near the image center and is not fully obstructed.

One square translucent/clear plate (appears to be acrylic) is visible directly above the concrete specimen, contacting the specimen's top surface; the plate's lower edges are visible and it is largely unobscured.
One circular metal platen or round metallic base is visible beneath the specimen, concentric rings are visible on its top surface; the platen fills much of the lower half of the image.
At least one vertical polished metal guide rod is visible at the left edge (partly cropped) beside the platen; its full extent is not visible.
One black cable or wire is visible behind the specimen on the right side of the image, running vertically and partly obscured by the specimen.

Background includes tiled wall panels (count not individually enumerated) and laboratory equipment partially visible and out of focus behind the specimen; these background items are not counted as distinct pieces of test apparatus in the photographed foreground.
